id.description: The step id: the screen's data-step attribute and its #id deep link.

app.description: The product the screen lives in (Flowpad, Google Cloud, GitHub).

title.description: What the user does on this screen, in a few words.

note.description: The detail the reviewer should react to.

branch_of.description: The step id this one branches from (a failure, a cancel); absent on the main path.

when.description: When the branch happens, e.g. 'if denied'.

next.description: Where this screen goes on, when not the next main-path screen (a branch's Try again).

scenario.description: Phase 1: what the user sees and does on this screen, in a sentence or two — the brief the screen is built from.

source.description: 'capture' (a live-app state the builder reaches and captures) or 'built: <why>' (drawn from the component source because the live app cannot reach it).

controls.description: Every clickable thing on the screen and its outcome; those with next become data-next, the rest data-dead.
